# Please file an issue instead

We do not accept pull requests, including small fixes and translation changes.

Please [file a detailed issue](https://github.com/inkeep/open-knowledge/issues/new/choose) describing the problem, steps to reproduce it, or the outcome you want. See [Write an issue we can build from](https://github.com/inkeep/open-knowledge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#write-an-issue-we-can-build-from).

Filing an issue does not commit the maintainers to building the change.
